narr: A stalled front across Pitt County on the evening of July 14th allowed multiple rounds of heavy rain and thunderstorms to move over the same area during the evening. With a very moist atmosphere in place, localized heavy rain over the City of Greenville caused flash flooding throughout the city. Multiple water rescues occurred due to cars stranded in water. The hardest hit area was Downtown Greenville.
ev: Multiple vehicles were stranded in flood waters near the intersection of 1st Street and Meade Street in Greenville.
Vehicle stranded in flood waters near Victoria Court in the south part of the City of Greenville.
Multiple water rescues were ongoing in downtown Greenville due to vehicles stranded in flood waters.
